I live in Madh Island with my dog and I have heel spurs in my left foot and tendinopathy in my right shoulder. I tried to source my psychiatric medicines from the island itself from two medical stores because immobility is something I struggle with. This took some time. To my surprise the man across the counter was highly rude and expected me to come get the medicines on the same date as the prescription! He even denied to accept a WhatsApp message from my doctor, who better than her, she is only one that can vouch for her patient. But he insisted to speak to her over the phone, with my psychiatrist that gives audio calls after one month of waiting and video call after two months. In this day and age denying online prescription and bills for reference is preposterous.

I had to request my doctor to furnish a new prescription and I limped all the way to Irla today to get the same medicines. And guess what he didn't even have all my medicines and was being bullish in all his conversations.

Maybe go to Diamond Chemist, at least they know how to behave like a human being!

Shame on you Amar Medical, fire this guy before your patrons abandon you! After 5 years I have!
